verdict.rationale: Devin's docs describe real-time visibility into agent actions, including a terminal view to watch commands and output logs, an Interactive Browser to observe and intervene in browsing tasks, and IDE takeover after a first draft — all supporting live observation and status awareness. However, there is no explicit unified 'status' dashboard evidence, and community feedback is skeptical about overall reliability/quality of the agent's autonomous work rather than the oversight UI itself, so confidence in completeness is limited.
